title: Update Lunar Climate Today content for all 27 Nakshatras

requirements.text: Update the Nakshatra data structure in backend/main.mo to include two new text fields: 'lunarClimate' (atmospheric daily transit description) and 'karmicLesson' (reflective wisdom for the day)

quotes: Ashwini days feel fast, instinctive, and catalytic...
Karmic lesson: Act with courage — but remember that beginnings require sustainability, not just speed.

acceptanceCriteria: Nakshatra type includes lunarClimate field as Text
Nakshatra type includes karmicLesson field as Text
Both fields are persisted in stable storage
